plan.name: Show when live steps really ended
plan.summary: The watcher records each agent-backed step's actual completion time, including stopped and failed attempts, and atomically keeps the latest finished step per repository with all exact ties, its original start, run, agent and time limit; heartbeats and watcher shutdown or restart preserve these records. Finished-step records stay separate from running steps: Factory.Finished func(Step) publishes completions separately, Factory.Activity and Factory.Steps remain running-only, and every new step starts without a run until its own fresh directory exists regardless of the issue's retained completion (D-0166); keep TestFactoryPublishesExplicitRunBeforeEveryDraft, TestFactoryRetryUsesFreshRunForModeledBuild and TestFactoryRetryUsesFreshRunForPlumbingBuild in internal/factory/live_run_accept_test.go passing unchanged. The dashboard reads recorded completions independently of page requests, including after its own restart, chooses the greatest recorded end across every watcher's status for each repository regardless of directory order or whether the watcher is stopped, retains every exact tie with its own watcher and run, freezes each finished card at that end and replaces the cards on a later completion while preserving the existing lease-holder and working-watcher selection for running steps. Wire dashboard.RecordActivity(backend synth.Backend, logf func(string, ...any)) synth.Backend into every watcher's draft and build backend so it atomically saves the named run's sanitized public activity in activity.json before the agent's workspace is cleaned up, including on error, cancellation or panic and after fallback, without a page request or any relaxation of existing path checks; finished cards prefer this saved activity, use the existing sanitized transcript reader for older completions without a snapshot, retain the named run's checks and an explicit ended heading supplied by live JSON, expose no private commands, and never guess a missing completion time. Update the existing completion fixtures, SPEC.md and README.md to describe these guarantees, the latest-finisher choice across watchers and preservation of activity after workspace deletion in issue #269, citing D-0051, D-0116, D-0159, D-0160, D-0165, D-0166 and D-0122 on changed SPEC bullets; the merger must record the new decision for watcher-recorded completion, the owner's latest-finisher choice and durable sanitized activity, which is not yet in the decision journal.

tests.name: TestFactoryPublishesTheDraftsActualEndTime
tests.says: The watcher publishes a draft's actual completion time and unchanged run identity through the separate Finished callback before removal; later no-op polls cannot invent another completion.

tests.name: TestFactoryPublishesEveryModeledBuildEnd
tests.says: Modeled builds publish exactly one completion on success, error, cancellation or recovered panic, in sequential and parallel scheduling.

tests.name: TestFactoryPublishesEveryPlumbingBuildEnd
tests.says: Plumbing builds publish their real completion on success, error, cancellation or recovered panic.

tests.name: TestFactoryKeepsFinishedRecordsSeparateFromRepeatedRuns269
tests.says: Drafts after answers and revisions, plus modeled and plumbing retries, retain distinct completion identities while every new invocation starts without a run until its own fresh directory exists; Activity and Steps never contain finished records.

tests.name: TestFinishedStatusSurvivesWritesHeartbeatsAndWatcherShutdown269
tests.says: Completed step metadata survives status writes, reloads, idle heartbeats, changed watcher timeouts and a persisted stopped PID without changing its original times or limit.

tests.name: TestFinishedStatusTracksLatestRealEndsAndTies269
tests.says: Status.Update keeps only running steps in the headline, accumulates the greatest recorded completion with all distinct tied runs, and ignores old, duplicate or runless completion events.

tests.name: TestLiveUsesRecordedEndAfterUnattendedCompletion
tests.says: A step that finishes while no page asks is read hours later with its actual end, original duration and limit, and final transcript counts; later reads do not move its end.

tests.name: TestLiveRestoresFinishedCardsAfterDashboardRestart
tests.says: A new dashboard restores a recorded finished card without ever observing it running, including from a stopped watcher's persisted status.

tests.name: TestLiveKeepsLatestFinishersAndTiesPerRepository
tests.says: Staggered completions leave the latest finisher per repository, exact ties keep both, and a later completion replaces them even if no page saw the intervening steps.

tests.name: TestLiveFinishedTitlesDescribeEndedAttempts
tests.says: The live JSON supplies distinct running and ended card titles for drafts, answers and builds without claiming that a stopped attempt succeeded.

tests.name: TestLiveFinishedCardsKeepPublicPrivacy
tests.says: A finished card retains counts and repository paths but publishes no agent text, command, output, model or outside path, including after a private read.

tests.name: TestLiveDoesNotInventUnrecordedCompletion
tests.says: A disappeared step without a watcher-recorded end is never stamped finished at the next read or from transcript activity.

tests.name: TestLiveSelectsLatestCompletionsAcrossWatchers269
tests.says: The latest recorded completion is selected across every watcher in either directory order, including stopped watchers; exact ties retain all cards with their own watcher activity even when issue and run names collide.

tests.name: TestFinishedActivitySurvivesWorkspaceCleanupWithoutPageReads269
tests.says: The watcher recorder saves only sanitized public activity before workspace cleanup for both agents, even on error, cancellation or panic; with no prior page read, restarted dashboards retain safe file paths, reads, sizes, tool kinds and times while preserving backend results and the separately recorded step end.

tests.name: TestFinishedActivityKeepsFallbackCountsAndIgnoresReview269
tests.says: Fallback attempts retain each primary-run event once in the saved activity, and review transcripts cannot replace that activity when the workspace is deleted before a finished card is read.
